reading.body:
This facility is a carrier hotel and colocation building in downtown Saint Louis, Missouri, at 210 North Tucker Boulevard. The 2022 expansion added 1.2 megawatts of critical IT capacity, which at a conservative 40 kilowatts per rack translates to roughly 30 racks of capacity. The total building spans 442,000 square feet with 800 tons of N+1 chilled water cooling, 13,800 kilovolt diverse utility feeds, and N+1 backup generators with 26,000 gallons of fuel.

The site holds SSAE 16 SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA, and PCI compliance certifications. It connects to more than 61 network providers and 4 internet exchanges, positioning it as a carrier interconnection point rather than a hyperscale compute facility. The building sits outside the 500 year flood plain and was acquired by Netrality from Digital Realty in 2016.

Missouri has no other facilities with published IT capacity figures, making this building the only one in the state with a disclosed megawatt figure. This is not evidence of dominance; it reflects that most data center operators do not publish capacity. The facility's orientation toward network density and carrier density suggests its value is in routing and interconnection rather than in hosting large pools of AI training or inference accelerators.
